name: @contextwindowarchitecture/assembler
description: A TypeScript assembler for the Context Window Architecture (CWA) draft specification

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:test && node --test "build/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.conformance: pnpm run build && node dist/cli/conformance.js vendor/cwa/conformance conformance-report.json
scripts.quickstart: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:test && node build/examples/quickstart.js
